title: Polynesian Fire Luau and Dinner Show Ticket in Myrtle Beach
includes: Tea & water included (cash bar available for other options)
Polynesian Fire Show in Myrtle Beach
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children 2 and under are free of charge
Limited free parking; parking lot across the street offers paid parking
No vegetarian options are available beyond what is offered on the buffet.
Cash bar. Bringing cash is recommended as additional cash-only items are available for purchase.
Shows will be performed in all weather conditions.
Shows may hold up to 160 guests.
Door Open 30 minutes Prior To Start Time
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Polynesian Fire Luau is one of the hottest shows in Myrtle Beach. The entertainment event features performers from different Polynesian Isles, just for the Luau. Your evening begins with a lei greeting by dancers. 

Then enjoy a buffet dinner accompanied with live music by our Polynesian band! After dinner, the show which highlights songs and dances from the different Polynesian cultures of Hawaii, Tahiti, Tonga, New Zealand and Samoa, begins. The night ends with an amazing performance by our World Champion Samoan Fire Knife Team.

Check in time is half hour prior to start time and the address is:
St John's Inn
6803 N Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach
